vue:
<template>
  <object ref="anim" type="image/svg+xml" data="/sunrise-badge.svg" aria-label="Sunrise badge"
    style="width:100%;max-width:640px" @load="onLoad" />
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, onBeforeUnmount } from "vue";

const anim = ref(null);
let player = null;

function onLoad() {
  player = anim.value.contentDocument?.getElementById("cin-svg")?.player;
  player.ready((p) => {
    p.on('end', () => console.log('finished'));
    // p.play(); p.pause(); p.reverse(); p.seek(50); p.set('speed', 2);
  });
}

onBeforeUnmount(() => player?.destruct());
</script>
svelte:
<script>
  import { onDestroy } from "svelte";
  let el;
  let player;

  function onLoad() {
    player = el.contentDocument?.getElementById("cin-svg")?.player;
    player?.ready((p) => p.on("end", () => console.log("finished")));
  }

  onDestroy(() => player?.destruct());
</script>

<object bind:this={el} on:load={onLoad} type="image/svg+xml" data="/sunrise-badge.svg"
  aria-label="Sunrise badge" style="width:100%;max-width:640px"></object>
